Commands:
  :mem | :memory                  inspect working + persistent memory
  :smart-memory [--json]          inspect episodic/procedural/consolidation memory
  :memory-consolidate [--json]    link episodes to reusable procedures now
  :audit [on|off|status]          read-only audit mode: freeze all durable memory writes
  :clear                          wipe working memory only
  :remember [tags] <text>         save to persistent memory (Write Policy gated)
  :forget [id|all]                delete persistent record(s)
  :ingest-source <path> [flags]   ingest one UTF-8 text/code file into Source Registry
  :ingest-project [path] [flags]  ingest project text/code files (default limit 80)
  :source-library [group|all]     list curated online source families
  :source-registry [flags]        list ingested sources and claim counts
      flags: --claims  --limit N  --json
  :source-review-plan <goal>      compare requested files/sources against Source Registry
      flags: --limit N  --json
  :implementation-plan <goal>     local source-backed implementation plan
      flags: --limit N  --json
  :patch-proposal-plan <goal>     local read-only patch proposal plan
      flags: --limit N  --json
  :self-build-propose             propose a self-build patch or NO_PATCH
  :self-build-supervisor          read-only supervisor: wait/stop/propose one candidate
  :ingest-web <topic> [flags]     search/fetch curated web library sources
      flags: --sources wikis|books|science|docs|all|id,id  --limit N  --per-source N
  :ingest-rss <url> [flags]       fetch RSS/Atom feed entries into Source Registry
      flags: --limit N  --dry-run  --write-memory  --no-memory
  :connectors [status] [--json]   list source connectors and rough costs
  :connector-plan <goal> [flags]  recommend source connectors for a task
      flags: --limit N  --json
  :models [--json]                inspect model routes and registry
  :refresh-models                 query providers, persist model catalog
  :model-registry-audit [--json] inspect selected vs available model candidates
  :model-discovery-audit [--json] local (no-network) provider discovery readiness
  :provider-catalog-refresh --dry-run [--anthropic] [--openai] [--json]
                                 dry-run live model discovery + catalog diff (no write)
  :architecture-audit [--json]   inspect layers and multi-agent gaps
  :operator-check [--json]       conversational project/status digest
  :operator-budget [--json]      concise budget + model usage digest
  :budget-config [--json]        inspect budget limit config and env overrides
  :urgent-status [--json]        approvals + queue + scheduler urgency digest
  :next-actions [--json]         architecture priorities + recommendations
  :autonomy-readiness [--json]   whether autonomy is safe to run now
  :dry-health-pass [--json]      local read-only autonomous health panel
  :coding-readiness [--json]     safe programming task readiness report
  :operator-task ... :end        one safe multi-line operator task report
  :task-begin ... :task-end       buffer a complex instruction (bypasses keyword router; :task-abort discards)
  :model-usage [--json]           inspect model calls/tokens/cost units
  :team-plan <goal> [--json]      dry-run bounded subagent contracts
  :team-run <goal> [--json]       dry-run execution walk over subagent contracts
  :capability-request <goal> [--submit] [--json]
                                    propose missing connector/capability boundaries
  :subagent-proposal <goal> [--submit]  autonomous subagent initiative proposal
  :learn [goal] [flags]           plan sources, then ingest selected learning set
  :learn-project [goal] [flags]   alias for :learn
      flags: --dry-run  --write-memory  --no-memory  --limit N
  :auto-run [goal] [flags]        bounded autonomous health pass
      flags: --dry-run  --allow-effects  --limit N  --learning-limit N  --no-tests
  :work-session [goal] [flags]    bounded multi-cycle session with time budget
      flags: --dry-run  --allow-effects  --minutes N  --max-cycles N  --report-every N
  :campaign-start [goal] [flags]  budgeted autonomous campaign with per-cycle ledger
      flags: --dry-run  --allow-effects  --cycles N  --max-llm-calls N  --max-cost-units N  --max-idle N
  :campaign-status [--recent N]   read the campaign ledger digest (no budget spent)
  :auto-status                    inspect autonomous runtime inbox/status
  :conflicts [--limit N|--json]   inspect source claim conflicts and suggestions
  :budget-status                  inspect default autonomous runtime budgets
  :budget-window-status [--json] inspect persistent hour/day budget windows
  :budget-kill-switch [--json] [--clear] inspect/reset autonomous day-budget kill-switch
  :state-store-drill [--json]    prove JSONL quarantine/recovery on an isolated file
  :release-audit [--json]         inspect release artifact hygiene exclusions
  :supply-chain-audit [--json]   inspect pinned deps and CI release gates
  :approval-list [status|all]     list pending/approved/denied approval items
  :approval-triage                read-only triage: clusters/duplicates/stale + advice
  :best-next-action [--json]      choose the single most important next action (advisory)
  :self-issue-verify <fingerprint> run the issue's fixed targeted verifier and resolve on green
  :ack <action> [--ttl H] [why]   acknowledge an advisory alert so it stops dominating BNA
  :ack-list                       list active acknowledgements
  :ack-clear <action>             restore an acknowledged alert to the top-pick race
  :approval-approve <id>          mark an approval inbox item approved
  :approval-deny <id>             mark an approval inbox item denied
  :approval-run <id>              execute one approved whitelisted operation
  :self-apply-run <id>            run one approved low-risk self-apply proposal
  :self-build-produce             produce one low-risk self-apply proposal into the inbox
  :self-split <path.py>           plan one deterministic incremental split step for an oversized module
  :self-task-propose              propose one coding task + failing test for approval (Stage A)
  :self-task-build <id>           implement an approved coding task so its frozen test passes (Stage B)
  :value-review <id> <verdict> [note]  record a human value verdict for an applied proposal
  :value-review-list              list applied self-build proposals and their value verdicts
  :approval-abort <id>            mark an approval inbox item aborted
  :inbox                          shortcut: list pending approvals
  :approve <id>                   shortcut: :approval-approve
  :deny <id>                      shortcut: :approval-deny
  :queue-status                   inspect runtime task queue summary
  :scheduler-status               inspect scheduler summary
  :task-add [goal] [flags]        enqueue persistent autonomous task
  :task-list [status|all]         list runtime tasks
  :task-run [--limit N]           run due pending runtime task(s)
  :task-cancel <task_id>          cancel one queued task
  :schedule-add <min> <goal>      create recurring scheduler entry
      flags: --name NAME  --no-tests  --limit N  --learning-limit N
  :schedule-list [status|all]     list schedules
  :schedule-disable <id>          disable a runtime schedule without running it
  :schedule-tick [--run]          enqueue due schedule tasks, optionally run them
  :hygiene [subcmd] [--dry-run]   memory hygiene; subcmd:
      backups    delete old .bak.<ts> files (keep last 3, >14d old)
      expire     drop persistent records past their TTL
      dedupe     collapse near-duplicate persistent records
      episodic   prune old low-quality episodes (retrieval distractors)
      summarise <tag>  merge records sharing <tag> via LLM
      archive [--threshold=N] [--min-age=N]  move low-value records to archive
      (no subcmd)      run expire, dedupe, episodic, then backups
  :rollback [plan_id]             apply latest compensation plan (or by id);
                                  no arg = LIFO pop; 'list' = show registered plans
  :repair <target> <proposal> [tests...] [--pattern PAT]
                                  guarded self-repair: diff, approval, write, tests, rollback
  :propose-repair <target> [tests...] [--pattern PAT] [--trace TRACE]
                                  generate a RepairProposal without writing files
  :assumptions [--json]           show the last 20 logged planning assumptions
  :help | ?                       show this command help
  :quit | :exit                   exit
  empty line                      ignored (use :quit or Ctrl+C to exit)

Conversational shortcuts:
  Check the project and tell me what needs attention
  Show which models are in use
  How many tokens were spent and what is the budget
  Is there anything urgent
  What should we do next
  Is autonomy ready to run
